decisions.decision: Phase 75 promoted to a `### Phase 75:` heading in .planning/ROADMAP.md (with Goal + Depends-on + Requirements lines)
decisions.rationale: GSD init resolver `getRoadmapPhaseInternal` only matches ##-#### headings under the active milestone in ROADMAP.md, not bullets or the milestone roadmap file. Without the heading, phase_found returns false and the workflow exits.

decisions.decision: Result schema name = `result.v2.json` (continues lineage from eval's implicit v1)
decisions.rationale: v1.12-ROADMAP and PROJECT.md both say v2; REQUIREMENTS.md BENCH-03 needs a one-line v1→v2 fix during write_context/planning.
Dedicated contract dir symmetrical to bench/{datasets,runners,...}. Adds a sixth top-level dir clarified in BENCH.md as contract-only.

decisions.decision: Strict additive-only bump policy: adding optional fields / new enum values for forward-compat consumers = minor; renaming/removing/narrowing/repurposing = major
decisions.rationale: 14 downstream phases need to assume metric stability across the milestone.

decisions.decision: Schema version surfaces as a single `schema_version: "v2"` string field in each result file
decisions.rationale: Simple, greppable; minor/patch tracked in .schema.json $id or a sidecar CHANGELOG.md.

decisions.decision: Move Phase 64 semantic microbench artifacts to internal/semantic/bench/ (git mv preserving filenames, single atomic refactor commit)
decisions.rationale: Frees the top-level bench/ for the v1.12 stack and matches the kernel/semantic boundary already enforced by vet-nokernel2semantic. Single commit preserves git log --follow continuity.

decisions.decision: BENCH-01 acceptance asserts 6 dirs at bench/ (datasets, runners, languages, evaluators, reports, schema)
decisions.rationale: schema/ is the contract dir; the other five are runtime. BENCH.md documents the distinction.

decisions.decision: eval↔bench separation enforced by prose only (INFRA-03 note in BENCH.md + reciprocal pointer paragraph in eval/EVAL.md); no vet analyzer this phase
decisions.rationale: Ship mechanical enforcement only when a real leakage shows up. Matches internal/lint/ precedent of landing analyzers when they have something to catch.

decisions.decision: Fairness contract = pure Go literal in bench/runners/fairness_contract.go (compile-time pin)
decisions.rationale: Snapshot bumps are a code change + PR + WaiverReason discussion. Reviewable in `git log fairness_contract.go`. No YAML/env-var back-channels.

decisions.decision: ModeOverride struct with free-text WaiverReason + ApprovedBy maintainer signoff; loader fatals on empty WaiverReason; overrides logged to result.v2.json.fairness.overrides[]
decisions.rationale: Free-text allows emergent reasons (e.g., baseline_rag needing higher max_tokens for chunk-stuffing) without code-change to add enum values; ApprovedBy gives audit trail.

decisions.decision: FAIR-02 deprecation gate via `deprecation_at: YYYY-MM-DD` field on each (provider, model_id) row of bench/datasets/cost-table.yaml; gate fires when deprecation_at - today < 30d
decisions.rationale: Static calendar keeps runs reproducible from `--run-id`; no live provider-API call. Staleness bounded by existing 90-day cost-table valid_until/last_verified rotation.

decisions.decision: FAIR-03 per-task variance gate: across N≥3 runs of the same (task, mode), flag when (max(tokens_input)−min(tokens_input))/mean(tokens_input) > 0.05
decisions.rationale: Fairness concern lives *within* a (task, mode) cell. Cached-input tokens reported as separate columns so cache-hit-rate variance is visible alongside. Reuses STATS-01 N≥3 — no separate sampling apparatus.
